Darren Yang AUO • 101 followers ​I recently conducted a small experiment: I had AI participate in a TFT-LCD engineering judgment. ​The answer provided by the AI was logically sound and physically reasonable—yet, in the actual manufacturing process, there were several points that were simply "impossible to occur." ​Once I pointed these out, it was quick to make corrections. ​This process reaffirmed one thing for me: ​AI makes us faster, but not necessarily more accurate. ​In high-precision manufacturing, what truly matters is often not the formulas themselves, but the judgments born from experience—knowing exactly which scenarios will not happen which is not reachable in internet. ​AI is a powerful tool, and I will continue to use it. ​However, at the end of the day, the one making the final decision is still the user! #display #TFTLCD #Arrayprocess #AI 3
